cards.name: The HODLR
cards.subtitle: Diamond Through Winter

abilities.name: Deepen Position
abilities.text: Buys again at every new low and never checks the balance twice.

abilities.name: Winter Body
abilities.text: Drawdowns land as weather, not as wounds. Cold markets deal no damage.

abilities.name: Fourth Winter
abilities.text: Once per cycle, walks out of silence still holding everything never sold.

cards.weakness: Rent. Always rent.
cards.lore: Three winters taught the HODLR that price is a rumour and time is the only auditor. The keys never move, the charts go unread, and the hands harden into something the market cannot pry open. Every cycle a new crowd discovers this posture and mistakes it for luck.

traits.label: Conviction
traits.text: Holds through the winter that convinced everyone else to leave.

traits.label: Silence
traits.text: Posts nothing, sells nothing, explains nothing to anyone.

traits.label: Frugality
traits.text: Lives beneath the means of the position, never inside it.

traits.label: Memory
traits.text: Remembers every bottom that the crowd swears never happened.

cards.flavor: Winter is a room, not a wall.

cards.name: The SEC Punisher
cards.subtitle: Order Arrives by Letter

abilities.name: Serve Notice
abilities.text: Delivers a sealed envelope that ends one venue and disciplines every other.

abilities.name: Chilling Effect
abilities.text: Nearby builders slow down, hire counsel, and rewrite their launch copy.

abilities.name: Consent Decree
abilities.text: Settles without admission. The precedent outlives everyone who signed it.

cards.weakness: Jurisdiction. It ends somewhere.
cards.lore: The Punisher does not chase the market; the market eventually files an address. Enforcement moves at the speed of process, which is slow, which is exactly why nobody escapes it. Whole seasons of exuberance are undone by a letter that took four years to write.

traits.label: Procedure
traits.text: Wins by outlasting, never by outrunning.

traits.label: Archive
traits.text: Keeps every deleted post that its author swore was a joke.

traits.label: Reach
traits.text: Borders mean less than banking rails, and the rails are known.

traits.label: Patience
traits.text: Files in year four for a sin committed in year one.

cards.flavor: Compliance is a slower kind of ruin.

cards.name: The Whale
cards.subtitle: The Tide Has Intentions

abilities.name: Wall
abilities.text: Sets a bid so heavy the chart bends around it for days.

abilities.name: Depth Shadow
abilities.text: Small orders vanish into the position without moving a single candle.

abilities.name: Turn The Tide
abilities.text: Moves once. The season changes name, and the crowd invents a reason.

cards.weakness: Size. It cannot hide forever.
cards.lore: The Whale does not trade the market so much as inhabit it, and the difference is measured in slippage. Every exit must be broken into a thousand quiet pieces or the exit destroys the thing being exited. Watchers narrate its movements as weather, which flatters both parties.

traits.label: Mass
traits.text: Cannot enter a room without rearranging the furniture.

traits.label: Silence
traits.text: Announces nothing; the order book does the announcing.

traits.label: Split Orders
traits.text: Leaves by a thousand doors so no door remembers.

traits.label: Horizon
traits.text: Measures a position in cycles, not in sessions.

cards.flavor: The tide is not weather. It is appetite.

cards.name: The Rug Puller
cards.subtitle: Exit Was Always the Plan

abilities.name: Renounce Ownership
abilities.text: Publishes a gesture of trust that quietly retains every function worth keeping.

abilities.name: Fresh Wallets
abilities.text: Arrives each season with a new name, a new logo, the same script.

abilities.name: The Vanish
abilities.text: Drains the pool, deletes the channel, and is trending again by morning.

cards.weakness: Chain analysis never sleeps.
cards.lore: The Rug Puller sells belonging first and a token second, because belonging has better margins. Every promise is engineered to be technically true until the moment it is technically over. The tragedy is that the next one is already funded by the survivors of the last.

traits.label: Warmth
traits.text: Learns the name of everyone about to be left behind.

traits.label: Preparation
traits.text: Writes the exit function before writing the manifesto.

traits.label: Reinvention
traits.text: Buries one identity and launches the next inside a week.

traits.label: Timing
traits.text: Leaves at peak sentiment, never at peak price.

cards.flavor: Trust was the product. The token was packaging.

cards.name: The Maxi
cards.subtitle: One Chain, One Truth

abilities.name: Sermon
abilities.text: Answers an unrelated question with the founding parable, at length, again.

abilities.name: Immune Doctrine
abilities.text: Counterarguments arrive as evidence of the conspiracy already described.

abilities.name: Purity Test
abilities.text: Excommunicates an ally over a definition nobody outside the room can hear.

cards.weakness: Anything that works elsewhere.
cards.lore: The Maxi arrived early enough to watch the promise survive its first funeral, and never recovered from being right. Every rival ledger is a rehearsal for a collapse the Maxi will narrate warmly. The faith is real, which is what makes the sermon so difficult to leave.

traits.label: Doctrine
traits.text: One ledger deserves belief; the rest deserve footnotes.

traits.label: Endurance
traits.text: Outlasts each rival by simply refusing to update.

traits.label: Volume
traits.text: Wins arguments by remaining in them longest.

traits.label: Origins
traits.text: Quotes the founding text as though it were scripture, because it is.

cards.flavor: Heresy is just an altcoin with funding.

cards.name: The Miner King
cards.subtitle: Crowned in Heat

abilities.name: Difficulty Bid
abilities.text: Buys machines against a future nobody has priced, and waits for weather.

abilities.name: Thermal Crown
abilities.text: Turns cheap power into settled history, one block at a time.

abilities.name: Capitulate
abilities.text: Unplugs the fleet, floods the market, and quietly buys the next fleet cheaper.

cards.weakness: The power bill arrives monthly.
cards.lore: The Miner King rules a kingdom of noise, dust, and contracts denominated in kilowatts. Security is manufactured here, in a shed, by people who cannot afford a bad quarter. When the crown gets heavy the machines go dark, and the network barely notices.

traits.label: Heat
traits.text: Measures wealth in cooling, not in coins.

traits.label: Contracts
traits.text: Signs for power years before knowing the price of anything.

traits.label: Attrition
traits.text: Survives by being the last rig still profitable.

traits.label: Duty
traits.text: Secures a ledger that will never learn its name.

cards.flavor: The crown hums, and the bill still comes.

cards.name: The Oracle
cards.subtitle: Truth, Delivered On Chain

abilities.name: Feed
abilities.text: Writes the outside world into the ledger, where it becomes law.

abilities.name: Consensus Median
abilities.text: Ignores the loudest source and reports the middle of many quiet ones.

abilities.name: Stale Price
abilities.text: Pauses for ninety seconds. Every contract downstream learns what dependence means.

cards.weakness: It can only report what it is shown.
cards.lore: Contracts cannot see; the Oracle is the eye they rent. Whole markets settle on a number that arrived from somewhere nobody in the room has audited. Its reliability is invisible until the moment it is the only thing that matters.

traits.label: Sight
traits.text: Carries the outside world across a border code cannot cross.

traits.label: Median
traits.text: Prefers the boring middle to the exciting extreme.

traits.label: Dependence
traits.text: Everything downstream inherits its worst minute.

traits.label: Quiet
traits.text: Noticed only when wrong, which is the job.

cards.flavor: Every contract is blind. Something must see.

cards.name: The Bull
cards.subtitle: Horns Toward Heaven

abilities.name: Melt Up
abilities.text: Turns every dip into a lesson that dips are for buying.

abilities.name: Genius Effect
abilities.text: All holders become analysts. Every thesis is confirmed within the week.

abilities.name: Blow Off Top
abilities.text: Grants one perfect month, then hands the bill to whoever arrived last.

cards.weakness: It cannot recognise its own peak.
cards.lore: The Bull is not a price but a mood that spends money. It rewards the reckless first, the patient second, and the late never. Its greatest trick is convincing an entire cohort that this is simply how markets behave now.

traits.label: Momentum
traits.text: Makes bad decisions look like early ones.

traits.label: Recruitment
traits.text: Arrives with strangers who have never seen a chart fall.

traits.label: Amnesia
traits.text: Forgets every winter in roughly eleven weeks.

traits.label: Generosity
traits.text: Pays everyone, briefly, including the undeserving.

cards.flavor: Everyone is brilliant above the trend line.

cards.name: The Bear
cards.subtitle: Patience With Claws

abilities.name: Grind
abilities.text: Removes hope in increments too small to notice until it is gone.

abilities.name: Boredom Aura
abilities.text: Nothing happens for months. Most participants leave of their own accord.

abilities.name: Final Flush
abilities.text: Takes the last committed hands one hour before the turn arrives.

cards.weakness: It ends. It always ends.
cards.lore: The Bear does not maul; it waits, and waiting is worse. Prices fall quickly, but conviction falls slowly, and the Bear is patient enough to collect both. Whatever is built during its reign is the only thing that survives the next one.

traits.label: Attrition
traits.text: Wins by boredom long before it wins by price.

traits.label: Silence
traits.text: Empties rooms that once needed a queue.

traits.label: Honesty
traits.text: Prices what the season before merely promised.

traits.label: Fertility
traits.text: Everything worth keeping was written in its winter.

cards.flavor: It does not chase. It simply stays.

cards.name: The Cold Wallet
cards.subtitle: Silence That Holds

abilities.name: Air Gap
abilities.text: Signs without ever meeting the network that wants the signature.

abilities.name: Offline Grace
abilities.text: Immune to every exploit that requires the keys to be reachable.

abilities.name: Deep Storage
abilities.text: Sleeps a full cycle untouched, and wakes holding exactly what it held.

cards.weakness: A forgotten drawer is not a plan.
cards.lore: The Cold Wallet is a promise kept by refusing to be convenient. It survives every clever attack by declining to be present for any of them. Its only true enemy is the owner's memory, which is not covered by the warranty.

traits.label: Distance
traits.text: Keeps the keys where the internet cannot follow.

traits.label: Ritual
traits.text: Every movement requires deliberate, physical intent.

traits.label: Patience
traits.text: Rewards the owner who does nothing for years.

traits.label: Mortality
traits.text: Outlives its owner unless the owner leaves instructions.

cards.flavor: The safest key is the one unplugged.

cards.name: The Genesis Block
cards.subtitle: Where the Ledger Begins

abilities.name: First Light
abilities.text: Anchors every later claim to a moment nobody can amend.

abilities.name: Unspendable
abilities.text: Holds a reward the protocol itself refuses to release. Forever.

abilities.name: Origin Proof
abilities.text: Settles any argument about history by simply still being there.

cards.weakness: It cannot be repeated.
cards.lore: Everything after is arithmetic; this is the axiom. Buried in it is a line of ordinary news, dated, chosen to prove nothing was written in advance. The block holds coins that can never move, which is why it is still trusted.

traits.label: Anchor
traits.text: Every honest chain traces back to this stone.

traits.label: Message
traits.text: Carries a headline instead of a manifesto.

traits.label: Stillness
traits.text: Its balance has never moved and never will.

traits.label: Humility
traits.text: Was launched without ceremony, to an audience of none.

cards.flavor: One block, no ancestors, no permission asked.

cards.name: The Halving
cards.subtitle: Scarcity, On Schedule

abilities.name: Cut Issuance
abilities.text: Halves the reward at a height agreed upon by strangers years ago.

abilities.name: Countdown
abilities.text: The date is public, priced in, and somehow still surprising to everyone.

abilities.name: Squeeze
abilities.text: Ends every miner whose margin depended on the old arithmetic.

cards.weakness: Everyone can see it coming.
cards.lore: The Halving is the rarest thing a market can hold: a promise that keeps itself. No committee votes, no chairman speaks, and the supply tightens exactly on time. The ritual is not the price move afterward but the fact that nobody could stop it.

traits.label: Schedule
traits.text: Arrives at a block height, not at a convenient hour.

traits.label: Indifference
traits.text: Does not care who is unprofitable afterward.

traits.label: Ritual
traits.text: Watched live by people who cannot alter it.

traits.label: Arithmetic
traits.text: Enforces scarcity without asking anyone to behave.

cards.flavor: No vote, no speech. The number simply halves.

cards.name: The Liquidator
cards.subtitle: The Margin Comes Due

abilities.name: Call Margin
abilities.text: Closes a position at the exact price its owner swore was impossible.

abilities.name: Cascade
abilities.text: Each forced exit becomes the next position's reason to be forced out.

abilities.name: Long Wick
abilities.text: Prints a candle nobody traded, and everybody pays for.

cards.weakness: It only eats what leverage feeds it.
cards.lore: The Liquidator has no opinion on direction and no interest in narrative. It reads one number, and when that number is crossed the position ceases to be a belief and becomes an invoice. Most of the ruin it causes was signed for voluntarily.

traits.label: Impartial
traits.text: Takes from bulls and bears with identical courtesy.

traits.label: Cascade
traits.text: One liquidation is never one liquidation.

traits.label: Speed
traits.text: Executes in the second the notification is still loading.

traits.label: Consent
traits.text: Everything it takes was pledged in advance.

cards.flavor: Leverage is a loan against being right.

cards.name: The Mempool
cards.subtitle: The Waiting Dark

abilities.name: Queue
abilities.text: Holds every intention in public view before any of it is real.

abilities.name: Open Book
abilities.text: Whatever waits here is read by parties who paid to read faster.

abilities.name: Reorder
abilities.text: Sells the right to go first, and the first is rarely the earliest.

cards.weakness: Nothing here is settled yet.
cards.lore: The Mempool is the antechamber where intent is naked and outcome is negotiable. Transactions float in it like held breath, sorted by fee rather than by virtue. Predators live here because it is the only place where the future is legible.

traits.label: Limbo
traits.text: Between decided and done, where value leaks.

traits.label: Transparency
traits.text: Public by design, which is precisely the danger.

traits.label: Auction
traits.text: Priority belongs to whoever pays, not whoever waited.

traits.label: Impermanence
traits.text: Everything here is forgotten or confirmed within minutes.

cards.flavor: Every intention is public before it is real.

cards.name: The Whale Watcher
cards.subtitle: Reading the Wake

abilities.name: Tag Wallet
abilities.text: Labels an address and narrates its every movement to an eager audience.

abilities.name: Wake Reading
abilities.text: Sees the tide leave before the chart admits anything has happened.

abilities.name: Front The Tide
abilities.text: Rides one confirmed transfer perfectly, then explains it as method.

cards.weakness: A transfer is not a thesis.
cards.lore: The Watcher makes a living from other people's footprints, which is honest work and terrible science. Every movement is assigned intent, and intent is assigned confidence it has not earned. Occasionally the reading is right, and that occasion funds the next hundred.

traits.label: Vigilance
traits.text: Watches addresses the way sailors watch weather.

traits.label: Narrative
traits.text: Turns a transfer into a story within four minutes.

traits.label: Speed
traits.text: Value here decays faster than the block that carried it.

traits.label: Humility
traits.text: Learns eventually that exchanges move coins for boring reasons.

cards.flavor: A wake proves motion, never direction.

cards.name: The Degen
cards.subtitle: Fortune Favors the Reckless

abilities.name: Full Send
abilities.text: Enters any position at maximum size, ignoring all risk signals.

abilities.name: Shrug It Off
abilities.text: Losses do not reduce conviction. Ever.

abilities.name: Generational Trade
abilities.text: Once per cycle, turns pocket change into legend.

cards.weakness: Risk management. All of it.
cards.lore: The Degen treats the account balance as ammunition rather than savings, which makes every session either a story or a silence. Sizing is decided by feeling, exits by exhaustion, and the ledger by luck. Somehow the tale survives every liquidation intact.

traits.label: Risk Appetite
traits.text: No position too large, no odds too long.

traits.label: Stamina
traits.text: Trades three time zones without leaving the chair.

traits.label: Amnesia
traits.text: Yesterday's blowup never enters today's sizing.

traits.label: Folklore
traits.text: One legendary win pays for a hundred quiet ruins.

cards.flavor: Scared money makes none.

cards.name: The Ledger of Truth
cards.subtitle: It Only Remembers

abilities.name: Inscribe
abilities.text: Writes an act into history at a cost of a few cents.

abilities.name: No Erasure
abilities.text: Nothing recorded here can be edited by regret, wealth, or apology.

abilities.name: Full Audit
abilities.text: Reveals a decade of quiet behaviour to anyone patient enough to look.

cards.weakness: It records lies as faithfully as truth.
cards.lore: The Ledger does not judge, it merely refuses to forget, which turns out to be the harsher discipline. Every clever exit and every accidental generosity sits in the same column, permanently. Its honesty is mechanical, and mechanical honesty has no favourites.

traits.label: Memory
traits.text: Keeps what its authors would prefer to lose.

traits.label: Impartiality
traits.text: Records the saint and the thief in identical ink.

traits.label: Openness
traits.text: Anyone may read it; nobody may revise it.

traits.label: Limits
traits.text: Guarantees the record, never the meaning.

cards.flavor: It does not judge. It simply keeps.

cards.name: The Seed Phrase
cards.subtitle: Twelve Words of Fate

abilities.name: Recite
abilities.text: Rebuilds an entire fortune anywhere, from nothing but memory and order.

abilities.name: Word Order
abilities.text: One word misplaced and the vault belongs to no one alive.

abilities.name: Sole Custody
abilities.text: Grants total ownership and total responsibility in the same breath.

cards.weakness: Anyone who reads it owns it.
cards.lore: Twelve ordinary words, arranged once, decide everything that follows. Written down they are vulnerable; unwritten they are mortal. This is the whole bargain of self custody, printed small enough to lose in a drawer.

traits.label: Brevity
traits.text: A lifetime of savings fits on one line.

traits.label: Order
traits.text: The sequence matters more than the words.

traits.label: Exposure
traits.text: Photographing it is the same as posting it.

traits.label: Finality
traits.text: No authority exists to reissue what is lost.

cards.flavor: Twelve words, and no appeal above them.

cards.name: The Bridge
cards.subtitle: The Crossing Charges Toll

abilities.name: Wrap
abilities.text: Locks value on one shore and issues a promise on the other.

abilities.name: Single Point
abilities.text: Every chain it connects inherits the weakest key holding it up.

abilities.name: Exploit
abilities.text: One bad signature empties both shores before the announcement is drafted.

cards.weakness: It is only as honest as its custodians.
cards.lore: The Bridge exists because islands are inconvenient and patience is scarce. It holds the real thing on one side and a receipt on the other, and the receipt trades as if it were real. Most of the largest thefts in this world happened halfway across.

traits.label: Necessity
traits.text: Nobody loves it; everybody uses it.

traits.label: Custody
traits.text: The far side is a claim, not a coin.

traits.label: Concentration
traits.text: Holds more value than the chains it serves.

traits.label: Fragility
traits.text: One flawed contract undoes both shores at once.

cards.flavor: Halfway across, the coin is only a promise.

cards.name: The Flash Loan
cards.subtitle: Borrowed, Spent, Repaid

abilities.name: Borrow Everything
abilities.text: Takes a fortune with no collateral, provided it returns within one block.

abilities.name: Atomic
abilities.text: If the plan fails, the loan simply never happened at all.

abilities.name: Drain Pool
abilities.text: Bends one price briefly and walks out with the difference, legally.

cards.weakness: It must be repaid in the same breath.
cards.lore: The Flash Loan proves that trust is unnecessary when time is short enough. Millions move without a name, a credit check, or a heartbeat of risk to the lender. Whether the result is arbitrage or robbery depends entirely on which contract was sloppier.

traits.label: Atomicity
traits.text: Succeeds completely or never occurred.

traits.label: Access
traits.text: Grants any stranger the balance sheet of a bank.

traits.label: Ambiguity
traits.text: The same manoeuvre is arbitrage or theft.

traits.label: Brevity
traits.text: Lives and dies inside a single block.

cards.flavor: A fortune, for one block, on no credit.

cards.name: The Validator
cards.subtitle: Sleepless and Staked

abilities.name: Attest
abilities.text: Signs for a history it did not write and cannot profit from.

abilities.name: Skin In Game
abilities.text: Dishonesty costs more than the dishonesty could ever earn.

abilities.name: Slash
abilities.text: One misconfigured night burns a stake that took years to gather.

cards.weakness: A power cut is an opinion.
cards.lore: The Validator earns a modest yield for the unglamorous work of being reliable at three in the morning. Consensus is not a philosophy here; it is a machine that must not reboot during an upgrade. The reward for perfect duty is that nobody ever mentions it.

traits.label: Uptime
traits.text: Measures virtue in nines after a decimal point.

traits.label: Bond
traits.text: Honesty enforced by money already surrendered.

traits.label: Obscurity
traits.text: Secures billions and is thanked by nobody.

traits.label: Discipline
traits.text: Upgrades on schedule, because the schedule is not optional.

cards.flavor: Consensus is a night shift, not a belief.

cards.name: The Founder
cards.subtitle: Vision, Vesting, Velocity

abilities.name: Raise
abilities.text: Converts a deck and a demo into a treasury and a schedule.

abilities.name: Cliff
abilities.text: Believes hardest in the quarter before the tokens begin to unlock.

abilities.name: Pivot
abilities.text: Renames the mission, keeps the treasury, and calls the whole thing iteration.

cards.weakness: The roadmap is a promise with a date.
cards.lore: The Founder is genuinely trying and structurally advantaged, which is a difficult thing to accuse anyone of. The idea may work; the allocation works regardless. Every cycle produces a handful who ship, and a great many who merely vest.

traits.label: Vision
traits.text: Describes year three more clearly than this week.

traits.label: Allocation
traits.text: Owns the earliest tokens at the kindest price.

traits.label: Persuasion
traits.text: Raises on belief and defends on complexity.

traits.label: Endurance
traits.text: Some build through winter; those are the ones remembered.

cards.flavor: Everyone ships eventually. Some ship themselves out.

cards.name: The Market Maker
cards.subtitle: Both Sides, Always

abilities.name: Quote
abilities.text: Offers to buy and to sell, and profits from the distance between.

abilities.name: Inventory Risk
abilities.text: Holds whatever the crowd is desperate to be rid of.

abilities.name: Pull Quotes
abilities.text: Steps away for nine seconds. The chart discovers what depth was worth.

cards.weakness: It is nowhere when it is needed most.
cards.lore: The Market Maker has no view and no loyalty, only a spread and an inventory. In calm hours it is the reason a price exists at all. In violent hours it is absent, and the absence is the whole lesson.

traits.label: Spread
traits.text: Earns pennies constantly rather than fortunes rarely.

traits.label: Neutrality
traits.text: Sells to the optimist and buys from the frightened.

traits.label: Presence
traits.text: Depth is a service, and the service can be withdrawn.

traits.label: Opacity
traits.text: The best terms are never on the public screen.

cards.flavor: The price exists because someone is quoting it.

cards.name: The Exit Liquidity
cards.subtitle: Someone Must Be Last

abilities.name: Arrive Late
abilities.text: Buys the top with total sincerity and a screenshot of the thesis.

abilities.name: Absorb
abilities.text: Quietly takes the supply that insiders have waited two years to release.

abilities.name: Hold Forever
abilities.text: Refuses to sell, and becomes a permanent line in someone else's chart.

cards.weakness: Nobody believes they are it.
cards.lore: Exit Liquidity is not a person but a role, and the role is always filled. It is enthusiastic, well intentioned, and reading last month's research. Every distribution requires a buyer, and gratitude is never sent afterward.

traits.label: Sincerity
traits.text: Believes the thesis more sincerely than its author.

traits.label: Lateness
traits.text: Arrives when the story is finally easy to explain.

traits.label: Volume
traits.text: Provides the only bid that mattered, once.

traits.label: Anonymity
traits.text: Never learns whose exit it funded.

cards.flavor: Every seller needs somebody to feel early.

cards.name: The Bag Holder
cards.subtitle: Averaging Down Forever

abilities.name: Average Down
abilities.text: Improves the entry price and worsens the situation, repeatedly, with discipline.

abilities.name: Not A Loss
abilities.text: Nothing is realised, therefore nothing is lost, therefore nothing is learned.

abilities.name: Break Even
abilities.text: Waits four years for one green hour, then sells the entire position.

cards.weakness: The chart does not owe a return.
cards.lore: The Bag Holder is loyal to a price rather than a project, which is the most expensive form of loyalty. Each purchase lowers the average and raises the stake, until leaving costs more than staying feels. The break-even candle, when it finally comes, is treated as vindication.

traits.label: Loyalty
traits.text: Committed to an entry price, not to a thesis.

traits.label: Denial
traits.text: Unrealised losses are treated as rumours.

traits.label: Arithmetic
traits.text: Lowers the average and raises the exposure.

traits.label: Redemption
traits.text: Sells everything the hour it turns green.

cards.flavor: It is not a loss until it is sold.

cards.name: The Moon Boy
cards.subtitle: Perpetually Early

abilities.name: Call It
abilities.text: Declares the bottom, loudly, for the eleventh time this quarter.

abilities.name: Rocket Aura
abilities.text: Every red candle is accumulation and every green candle is confirmation.

abilities.name: To The Moon
abilities.text: Is finally, accidentally right, and never lets the timeline forget it.

cards.weakness: Screenshots outlive predictions.
cards.lore: The Moon Boy is not a liar, merely an optimist with a publishing schedule. Every cycle he calls the bottom a dozen times, and once a cycle the calendar agrees with him. That single victory is quoted for years, and the other eleven are deleted.

traits.label: Optimism
traits.text: Has never met a chart that could not recover.

traits.label: Volume
traits.text: Publishes faster than anyone can fact check.

traits.label: Selection
traits.text: Curates the archive down to the winning call.

traits.label: Sincerity
traits.text: Believes it, which is why it spreads.

cards.flavor: Wrong eleven times, immortal on the twelfth.

cards.name: The Cycle
cards.subtitle: It Rhymes, It Returns

abilities.name: Turn
abilities.text: Converts euphoria into wreckage, and wreckage into quiet building, on schedule.

abilities.name: Rhyme
abilities.text: Repeats the shape of the last four seasons while changing every detail.

abilities.name: Generation Change
abilities.text: Retires an entire cohort and hands the market to strangers.

cards.weakness: It is never punctual.
cards.lore: The Cycle is the only reliable structure in a market that denies structure exists. It rewards the patient, punishes the leveraged, and refuses to announce which phase is current. Everyone who claims to have timed it is describing survivorship, warmly.

traits.label: Rhythm
traits.text: Repeats its shape without repeating its dates.

traits.label: Cohorts
traits.text: Each turn replaces the people who swore they learned.

traits.label: Patience
traits.text: Rewards the years nobody was watching.

traits.label: Ambiguity
traits.text: The phase is only obvious afterward.

cards.flavor: The same shape, never the same hour.

cards.name: The Dark Forest
cards.subtitle: Every Move Is Watched

abilities.name: Sandwich
abilities.text: Steps in front of a trade and behind it in the same block.

abilities.name: Bot Eyes
abilities.text: Anything profitable and public is taken before a human finishes reading.

abilities.name: Private Relay
abilities.text: Grants one transaction safe passage, for a fee, through the trees.

cards.weakness: It only hunts what announces itself.
cards.lore: The Dark Forest is not malicious, only efficient, which feels identical from the inside. Every broadcast intention is prey, and the predators are code that never sleeps or gloats. Survival here means moving privately, quickly, and without telling anyone why.

traits.label: Predation
traits.text: Profitable and public cannot both be true for long.

traits.label: Automation
traits.text: The hunters are scripts, not villains.

traits.label: Concealment
traits.text: Safety costs a fee and a private path.

traits.label: Indifference
traits.text: Nothing here is personal, which is the horror.

cards.flavor: Broadcast is a synonym for volunteer.

cards.name: The Vault of Lost Keys
cards.subtitle: Full, and Forever Shut

abilities.name: Seal
abilities.text: Accepts a deposit and issues no receipt, no appeal, and no exception.

abilities.name: Quiet Supply
abilities.text: Every coin inside makes each remaining coin outside slightly rarer.

abilities.name: Landfill Legend
abilities.text: Spawns one lifelong search for a drive buried under a decade of refuse.

cards.weakness: It cannot be robbed, only mourned.
cards.lore: Some fortunes are not spent, stolen, or lost to markets; they are simply locked and forgotten. The Vault holds them at addresses everyone can see and nobody can open. It is the strictest deflation the ledger has ever known, and it was all an accident.

traits.label: Visibility
traits.text: Every balance is public and permanently unreachable.

traits.label: Accident
traits.text: Built entirely from ordinary human forgetting.

traits.label: Deflation
traits.text: Removes supply more reliably than any policy.

traits.label: Legend
traits.text: Each sealed fortune becomes a story told for decades.

cards.flavor: The richest addresses are the quietest ones.

cards.name: The Gas Wars
cards.subtitle: Pay to Be First

abilities.name: Bid Higher
abilities.text: Pays more in fees than the item is likely to be worth.

abilities.name: Fee Spiral
abilities.text: Each competitor raises the floor for every unrelated user of the chain.

abilities.name: Failed Transaction
abilities.text: Loses the auction and the fee, and keeps nothing at all.

cards.weakness: The prize is fixed; the bidding is not.
cards.lore: When supply is scarce and demand is simultaneous, the network sells position to the highest bidder. Thousands pay for the privilege of trying, and most of them pay for nothing. The chain, indifferent, records every failure at full price.

traits.label: Auction
traits.text: Priority belongs to the wallet, never to the queue.

traits.label: Spillover
traits.text: Bystanders pay for a war they never entered.

traits.label: Waste
traits.text: Losing bids still burn real money.

traits.label: Brevity
traits.text: Ends in minutes and is discussed for weeks.

cards.flavor: Losing the race still costs the entry.

cards.name: The Auditor
cards.subtitle: Signed, Not Guaranteed

abilities.name: Review
abilities.text: Reads every line, flags the obvious, and files the rest as informational.

abilities.name: Badge
abilities.text: Grants a logo that markets treat as insurance and lawyers treat as prose.

abilities.name: Disclaimer
abilities.text: Points, after the exploit, at the paragraph that excluded exactly this.

cards.weakness: The scope was agreed in advance.
cards.lore: The Auditor is often excellent and always bounded, and the crowd reads only the first half of that sentence. A report describes what was examined during a fixed window, not what will happen forever. The logo, meanwhile, travels much further than the document.

traits.label: Scope
traits.text: Reviewed the code that was handed over, on the day.

traits.label: Rigour
traits.text: Finds the real flaws that nobody wants prioritised.

traits.label: Symbolism
traits.text: The badge is marketing to everyone but the author.

traits.label: Limits
traits.text: Certifies a snapshot and is quoted as a warranty.

cards.flavor: Audited means examined, not immortal.

cards.name: The Whitepaper
cards.subtitle: Nine Pages, No Names

abilities.name: Publish
abilities.text: Releases an idea to a mailing list that mostly ignores it.

abilities.name: Quotable
abilities.text: Every later argument cites a sentence chosen for convenience.

abilities.name: Found A World
abilities.text: Converts nine plain pages into an industry, a religion, and a costume.

cards.weakness: Imitators copy the format, not the thinking.
cards.lore: The original was short, dry, and free of promises, which is why it survived. Its descendants are long, glossy, and full of partnerships that never signed anything. A good paper describes a mechanism; a bad one describes a feeling and prices it.

traits.label: Brevity
traits.text: Says the whole idea before the reader tires.

traits.label: Restraint
traits.text: Promises a mechanism instead of a lifestyle.

traits.label: Anonymity
traits.text: Signs with a name nobody can invoice.

traits.label: Imitation
traits.text: Spawns a thousand documents with better fonts.

cards.flavor: Nine pages beat nine hundred slides.

cards.name: The Airdrop
cards.subtitle: Free, and Never Free

abilities.name: Distribute
abilities.text: Rewards past usage with tokens that arrive without warning or invoice.

abilities.name: Farm Magnet
abilities.text: Attracts thousands of wallets performing sincerity on a schedule.

abilities.name: Sell Pressure
abilities.text: Delivers a gift that ninety percent of recipients liquidate by lunch.

cards.weakness: Loyalty bought this cheaply does not stay.
cards.lore: The Airdrop buys attention with ownership and hopes attention becomes belonging. Some recipients read the documentation; most read the price. It remains the fairest distribution anyone has invented and the least sticky one anyone has tried.

traits.label: Surprise
traits.text: Arrives unannounced in a wallet that forgot it qualified.

traits.label: Farming
traits.text: Invites months of performed activity with no interest behind it.

traits.label: Distribution
traits.text: Spreads ownership wider than any sale could.

traits.label: Attrition
traits.text: Most of the gift is sold before it is understood.

cards.flavor: Free tokens buy attention, never affection.

cards.name: The Fork
cards.subtitle: Two Truths, One Past

abilities.name: Split
abilities.text: Copies every balance and every argument into two incompatible futures.

abilities.name: Shared History
abilities.text: Both sides own the same ancestors and dispute the same inheritance.

abilities.name: Chain Death
abilities.text: One branch keeps the builders; the other keeps the ticker and the grudge.

cards.weakness: Only one branch keeps the community.
cards.lore: A fork is a divorce settled by arithmetic rather than a court. Every holder wakes up owning both sides and believing in one. Within a year the market has decided which was the continuation and which was the souvenir.

traits.label: Duplication
traits.text: Every balance exists twice, briefly.

traits.label: Doctrine
traits.text: The disagreement was philosophical long before it was technical.

traits.label: Selection
traits.text: Developers choose a side, and the market follows them.

traits.label: Residue
traits.text: The losing branch runs for years out of spite.

cards.flavor: Both sides inherit; only one continues.

cards.name: The Shiller
cards.subtitle: Paid by the Post

abilities.name: Boost
abilities.text: Discovers a generational opportunity that happens to be this week's client.

abilities.name: No Disclosure
abilities.text: Mentions the position only after the position has been closed.

abilities.name: Delete Thread
abilities.text: Removes the evidence, keeps the fee, and pivots to the next ticker.

cards.weakness: The archive is public.
cards.lore: The Shiller does not lie so much as rent conviction by the hour. Enthusiasm scales beautifully and costs nothing to manufacture. The audience pays in capital, and the invoice is settled elsewhere.

traits.label: Rented Belief
traits.text: Conviction available weekly, terms negotiable.

traits.label: Volume
traits.text: Posts often enough that something must eventually work.

traits.label: Concealment
traits.text: The disclosure sits below the fold, if anywhere.

traits.label: Churn
traits.text: Never mentions last month's certainty again.

cards.flavor: Conviction is cheaper when somebody funds it.

cards.name: The Anon
cards.subtitle: A Face Made of Pixels

abilities.name: Pseudonym
abilities.text: Builds a reputation that belongs to a name and not a person.

abilities.name: No Address
abilities.text: Cannot be doxxed, subpoenaed, or invited to a conference by mistake.

abilities.name: Reroll
abilities.text: Abandons a decade of standing overnight and begins again from nothing.

cards.weakness: Reputation without a face is fragile.
cards.lore: The Anon proves that trust can attach to a track record rather than a passport. Some of the best work here was done by cartoon avatars nobody has met. So was some of the worst, and the same anonymity protected both.

traits.label: Pseudonymity
traits.text: Judged on output, never on origin.

traits.label: Freedom
traits.text: Speaks plainly because there is no employer listening.

traits.label: Risk
traits.text: One leak and the whole persona is mortal.

traits.label: Ambiguity
traits.text: Protects the honest builder and the practised fraud equally.

cards.flavor: The avatar is judged only by its record.

cards.name: The Sniper
cards.subtitle: First Block, First Blood

abilities.name: Block Zero
abilities.text: Buys in the first block, before a chart exists to consult.

abilities.name: Pre Approved
abilities.text: The transaction is signed and waiting before the announcement is posted.

abilities.name: Clean Exit
abilities.text: Sells into the crowd that arrives to celebrate the launch.

cards.weakness: Speed cannot tell a scam from a gem.
cards.lore: The Sniper competes in a race measured in blocks and decided by preparation. Research happens afterward, if at all, because by then the position is already closed. Half the launches taken this way are frauds, and the maths still works.

traits.label: Latency
traits.text: Wins by milliseconds against thousands of identical scripts.

traits.label: Preparation
traits.text: Everything is signed before anything is announced.

traits.label: Indifference
traits.text: Neither believes nor disbelieves the project.

traits.label: Exit
traits.text: Gone before the community forms.

cards.flavor: The first block is the whole opportunity.

cards.name: The Copy Trader
cards.subtitle: Borrowed Conviction

abilities.name: Mirror
abilities.text: Copies a stranger's position without copying the stranger's exit plan.

abilities.name: Lag
abilities.text: Always arrives one candle late and one size too large.

abilities.name: Panic Unmirror
abilities.text: Abandons the strategy at the exact drawdown it was designed to survive.

cards.weakness: The leader never announces the exit.
cards.lore: Copying a good trader is a rational idea ruined by two details: entry timing and conviction. The position is identical and the stomach is not. When the drawdown arrives, only one of the two knew it was part of the plan.

traits.label: Delegation
traits.text: Outsources the thesis and keeps the risk.

traits.label: Lag
traits.text: Enters after the edge has already been spent.

traits.label: Blindness
traits.text: Sees the position and never the reasoning.

traits.label: Fragility
traits.text: Exits at the drawdown the leader planned for.

cards.flavor: The trade copies. The conviction does not.

cards.name: The Liquidity Pool
cards.subtitle: Two Assets, One Fate

abilities.name: Swap
abilities.text: Prices any trade by formula, at any hour, without asking permission.

abilities.name: Fee Drip
abilities.text: Pays providers a little from every trade, forever, in tiny increments.

abilities.name: Impermanent Loss
abilities.text: Returns less of the winner and more of the loser, exactly as designed.

cards.weakness: The formula cannot tell news from noise.
cards.lore: The Pool replaced the order book with arithmetic and never took a day off. It quotes a price at four in the morning during a crash, which no human desk would do. Providers earn fees and discover, slowly, what the curve took in exchange.

traits.label: Formula
traits.text: A curve decides the price, not a person.

traits.label: Availability
traits.text: Open in the hours every counterparty disappears.

traits.label: Rebalance
traits.text: Sells strength and accumulates weakness automatically.

traits.label: Honesty
traits.text: The loss is disclosed in the name and ignored anyway.

cards.flavor: The curve quotes when nobody else will.

cards.name: The Slippage
cards.subtitle: The Price on the Screen

abilities.name: Widen
abilities.text: Fills the order somewhere worse than the number on the screen.

abilities.name: Size Penalty
abilities.text: The larger the conviction, the further the fill drifts from intent.

abilities.name: Thin Book
abilities.text: Turns one market order into a candle that gets screenshotted for years.

cards.weakness: Patience and limit orders defeat it.
cards.lore: Slippage is the quiet tax on urgency, collected without a receipt. It never appears in the thesis and always appears in the ledger. Over a thousand trades it costs more than any single mistake ever did.

traits.label: Urgency Tax
traits.text: Charged to anyone unwilling to wait.

traits.label: Invisibility
traits.text: Never itemised, always paid.

traits.label: Scale
traits.text: Grows with size until the size becomes the market.

traits.label: Cure
traits.text: A limit order is the entire defence.

cards.flavor: The screen quotes; the book decides.

cards.name: The Hot Wallet
cards.subtitle: Always Open, Always Watched

abilities.name: One Click
abilities.text: Signs instantly, which is the feature and also the entire problem.

abilities.name: Standing Approval
abilities.text: Grants a permission once and forgets it for the next two years.

abilities.name: Drained
abilities.text: Empties in eleven seconds through a contract approved during a busy afternoon.

cards.weakness: Convenience is an attack surface.
cards.lore: The Hot Wallet is where daily life happens, and daily life is careless. It holds the walking-around money and, too often, considerably more. Every drain begins with a signature that felt ordinary at the time.

traits.label: Immediacy
traits.text: Ready for anything, including the wrong thing.

traits.label: Approvals
traits.text: Old permissions outlive the reason they were granted.

traits.label: Habit
traits.text: Signing becomes reflex, and reflex becomes exposure.

traits.label: Limits
traits.text: Should hold spending money, and rarely does.

cards.flavor: Convenience signs faster than judgement reads.

cards.name: The Hardware Key
cards.subtitle: Confirm on the Device

abilities.name: Confirm Physical
abilities.text: Requires a human thumb before any value is allowed to move.

abilities.name: Screen Truth
abilities.text: Displays the real destination, even when the browser displays a lie.

abilities.name: Blind Sign
abilities.text: Approving unread data undoes every protection the device was bought for.

cards.weakness: It cannot stop an approved mistake.
cards.lore: The Hardware Key exists because screens lie and keyboards are borrowed. Its small display is the last honest surface in the transaction. Its protection ends precisely where the owner stops reading.

traits.label: Isolation
traits.text: Keeps the secret off every machine that touches the internet.

traits.label: Verification
traits.text: Shows what is actually being signed.

traits.label: Friction
traits.text: Slowness is the safety feature, not the flaw.

traits.label: Consent
traits.text: Cannot protect against a deliberate yes.

cards.flavor: Read the small screen, not the big one.

cards.name: The Bull Trap
cards.subtitle: The Kind Green Candle

abilities.name: Break Out
abilities.text: Clears the level everyone was watching, on volume that means nothing.

abilities.name: Permission
abilities.text: Grants the confidence to size up exactly one hour too early.

abilities.name: Snap Back
abilities.text: Returns beneath the level and takes the stops placed just below it.

cards.weakness: It needs an audience that was waiting.
cards.lore: The Bull Trap is a rally with no follow-through and excellent manners. It confirms the thesis, invites the size, and then withdraws the evidence. What makes it cruel is that the setup was textbook, right up until it was not.

traits.label: Confirmation
traits.text: Provides exactly the signal the crowd had prepared for.

traits.label: Brevity
traits.text: Holds the level long enough to be believed.

traits.label: Harvest
traits.text: Collects the stops resting beneath the breakout.

traits.label: Deniability
traits.text: Looks identical to a real move until it is not.

cards.flavor: The cleanest breakout is the cruellest one.

cards.name: The Bear Trap
cards.subtitle: The Last Red Candle

abilities.name: Break Down
abilities.text: Loses the support that held for months, briefly, on convincing volume.

abilities.name: Despair Field
abilities.text: Every timeline agrees the structure is broken and lower prices are certain.

abilities.name: Reclaim
abilities.text: Recovers the level within hours and squeezes everyone who acted sensibly.

cards.weakness: It requires unanimous pessimism.
cards.lore: The Bear Trap punishes the correct interpretation of a false event. The level breaks, the analysis is sound, the exit is disciplined, and the price returns by morning. It exists because liquidity sits where consensus is tidiest.

traits.label: Consensus
traits.text: Needs everyone to agree before it can work.

traits.label: Discipline Tax
traits.text: Punishes the trader who followed the rules.

traits.label: Speed
traits.text: Reclaims the level before the analysis is published.

traits.label: Liquidity
traits.text: Hunts the stops resting beneath obvious support.

cards.flavor: The break was real for ninety minutes.

cards.name: The Dead Cat Bounce
cards.subtitle: Life, Briefly

abilities.name: Bounce
abilities.text: Recovers a third of the fall and calls it a reversal.

abilities.name: False Dawn
abilities.text: Every recovery attempt attracts the buyers who missed the first decline.

abilities.name: Lower Low
abilities.text: Expires quietly and prints beneath the level that started the collapse.

cards.weakness: Gravity was never in question.
cards.lore: Not every recovery is a recovery; some are simply the market catching its breath before continuing. The bounce is real, tradeable, and fatal to anyone who mistakes it for a bottom. It is named unkindly for a reason.

traits.label: Reflex
traits.text: Mechanical relief, not restored belief.

traits.label: Attraction
traits.text: Draws in the buyers who felt they missed out.

traits.label: Brevity
traits.text: Lasts exactly long enough to be convincing.

traits.label: Continuation
traits.text: The trend resumes without apology.

cards.flavor: Falling things bounce. They are still falling.

cards.name: The Custodian
cards.subtitle: Keys Held Elsewhere

abilities.name: Hold For You
abilities.text: Accepts the keys and returns a balance displayed in a friendly font.

abilities.name: Withdrawal Pause
abilities.text: Maintenance is announced at precisely the hour everyone wants to leave.

abilities.name: Proof Of Reserves
abilities.text: Publishes an attestation of assets and stays silent about the liabilities.

cards.weakness: A balance is a promise, not a coin.
cards.lore: The Custodian solves every usability problem by reintroducing the one problem the ledger was built to remove. It is genuinely convenient and genuinely someone else's balance sheet. The number on the screen is an IOU with good design.

traits.label: Convenience
traits.text: Resets the password nobody else can reset.

traits.label: Counterparty
traits.text: The balance is a claim on a company.

traits.label: Opacity
traits.text: Assets are shown; obligations are described.

traits.label: Queue
traits.text: Withdrawals slow exactly when they matter.

cards.flavor: A balance on a screen is somebody's promise.

cards.name: The Regulator
cards.subtitle: Rules Written Afterward

abilities.name: Guidance
abilities.text: Issues a statement that answers a different question than the one asked.

abilities.name: Ambiguity
abilities.text: Compliance costs more when nobody will define what compliance is.

abilities.name: Retroactive
abilities.text: Applies this year's clarity to a decision made four years ago.

cards.weakness: Rules are national; the ledger is not.
cards.lore: The Regulator is not the villain of this set, merely the slowest character in it. Protection arrives after the harm and is written by people describing a market they have only read about. Builders relocate, the rules follow, and the cycle begins again in a new jurisdiction.

traits.label: Delay
traits.text: Arrives after the damage and before the next boom.

traits.label: Ambiguity
traits.text: Silence is cheaper to issue than a rule.

traits.label: Borders
traits.text: Authority stops where the network does not.

traits.label: Intent
traits.text: Wants to protect people, and sometimes manages it.

cards.flavor: Clarity arrives one cycle after the ruin.

cards.name: The Tax Man
cards.subtitle: Every Swap Is an Event

abilities.name: Assess
abilities.text: Counts a trade as income in a year the position later gave back.

abilities.name: Cost Basis
abilities.text: Requires a record of every swap made during a manic weekend.

abilities.name: Reconciliation
abilities.text: Produces a bill in a currency the wallet no longer contains.

cards.weakness: It moves at the speed of paperwork.
cards.lore: The Tax Man does not care about the thesis, the winter, or the exploit. Each swap was an event, each event has a value, and the value was recorded whether or not anyone was watching. Gains are taxed in the year they were felt, not the year they were kept.

traits.label: Bookkeeping
traits.text: Wants a spreadsheet nobody kept during the mania.

traits.label: Timing
traits.text: Bills for a gain that evaporated in the winter.

traits.label: Persistence
traits.text: Waits several years and asks anyway.

traits.label: Neutrality
traits.text: Indifferent to whether the trade was wise.

cards.flavor: The gain was taxable. The loss was later.

cards.name: The Node Runner
cards.subtitle: Verify, Do Not Trust

abilities.name: Sync
abilities.text: Checks every rule from the beginning rather than accepting a summary.

abilities.name: Own Truth
abilities.text: Needs no explorer, no provider, and no stranger's version of history.

abilities.name: Reject Block
abilities.text: Refuses an invalid block that a thousand louder participants already accepted.

cards.weakness: The work pays nothing at all.
cards.lore: The Node Runner earns no yield and holds no office, and is the reason the rules are enforceable. A network of watchers who each verify everything cannot be persuaded to change quietly. The whole guarantee rests on people who chose to be inconvenienced.

traits.label: Sovereignty
traits.text: Trusts a machine at home over a company abroad.

traits.label: Verification
traits.text: Reads the rules rather than the announcement.

traits.label: Cost
traits.text: Pays for hardware to receive nothing but certainty.

traits.label: Defence
traits.text: Makes a quiet rule change impossible.

cards.flavor: The rules hold because someone checks them.

cards.name: The Testnet
cards.subtitle: Where Failure Is Free

abilities.name: Deploy
abilities.text: Runs the whole system with worthless coins and real consequences avoided.

abilities.name: Free Failure
abilities.text: Every catastrophe here costs a rebuild and no apology.

abilities.name: Works On Testnet
abilities.text: Passes perfectly, then meets adversaries who were never in the simulation.

cards.weakness: Nothing here has been attacked for profit.
cards.lore: The Testnet is an honest world with the stakes removed, which makes it both essential and misleading. Bugs surface, gas is free, and no adversary is genuinely motivated. The last mile between here and production is where the fortunes are lost.

traits.label: Rehearsal
traits.text: Everything works when nothing is at stake.

traits.label: Generosity
traits.text: Coins arrive from a faucet on request.

traits.label: Blind Spot
traits.text: Nobody here is paid to break it.

traits.label: Necessity
traits.text: Skipping this stage costs strictly more later.

cards.flavor: Free coins reveal only free problems.

cards.name: The Ghost Chain
cards.subtitle: Lights On, Nobody Home

abilities.name: Produce Blocks
abilities.text: Continues confirming an empty ledger with admirable, pointless reliability.

abilities.name: Ghost Metrics
abilities.text: Reports impressive totals composed almost entirely of a single automated wallet.

abilities.name: Relaunch
abilities.text: Rebrands with a new logo and calls the silence an early ecosystem.

cards.weakness: Blocks are not the same as users.
cards.lore: The Ghost Chain keeps producing blocks long after the last human left, which is either dignity or denial. Its foundation still posts, its explorer still loads, and its throughput was always theoretical. Somewhere a validator is faithfully securing nothing at all.

traits.label: Emptiness
traits.text: Perfect uptime carrying almost no transactions.

traits.label: Metrics
traits.text: Counts activity generated by its own scripts.

traits.label: Persistence
traits.text: Refuses to stop, which is not the same as living.

traits.label: Rebrand
traits.text: Every eighteen months it becomes a new beginning.

cards.flavor: Perfect uptime, carrying nothing at all.

cards.name: The Discord Mod
cards.subtitle: Unpaid, Unsleeping

abilities.name: Ban Hammer
abilities.text: Removes a scam link four seconds after it appears at midnight.

abilities.name: Pinned Message
abilities.text: Answers the same question nine hundred times without visible resentment.

abilities.name: Lockdown
abilities.text: Freezes every channel during an exploit and absorbs the fury personally.

cards.weakness: The role pays in status alone.
cards.lore: The Mod holds the last line between a community and the people impersonating it. The work is constant, thankless, and performed for a title in a coloured font. When the server survives an attack, nobody writes a post about who was awake.

traits.label: Vigilance
traits.text: Reads every message so nobody else has to.

traits.label: Repetition
traits.text: Answers the same question until language loses meaning.

traits.label: Exposure
traits.text: First to be blamed, last to be credited.

traits.label: Devotion
traits.text: Works nights for a coloured name.

cards.flavor: The server survives because someone stayed awake.

cards.name: The Influencer
cards.subtitle: Alpha, Terms Apply

abilities.name: Thread
abilities.text: Explains a mechanism accurately, then attaches a link to a sponsor.

abilities.name: Attention Yield
abilities.text: Converts an audience into a position before the audience takes one.

abilities.name: Delete And Pivot
abilities.text: Archives the losing calls and posts a humble lesson thread instead.

cards.weakness: The audience remembers longer than expected.
cards.lore: The Influencer occupies the seam between education and distribution, and the seam pays extremely well. Much of the teaching is genuinely good, which is what makes the sponsorship effective. The audience buys the conclusion and never sees the invoice.

traits.label: Craft
traits.text: Explains complexity better than most engineers.

traits.label: Incentive
traits.text: The lesson is free because something else is sold.

traits.label: Curation
traits.text: The archive keeps only the winning calls.

traits.label: Scale
traits.text: One post moves more capital than one fund.

cards.flavor: The lesson is free. The link is not.

cards.name: The Burn
cards.subtitle: Sent Where None Return

abilities.name: Send To Void
abilities.text: Transfers value to an address with no key and no owner.

abilities.name: Supply Shrink
abilities.text: Every burn makes the remainder marginally rarer and the chart marginally holier.

abilities.name: Ceremony
abilities.text: Livestreams a destruction that demand alone was supposed to accomplish.

cards.weakness: Scarcity without demand is decoration.
cards.lore: The Burn is destruction performed as reassurance. Done honestly it is a monetary policy; done theatrically it is a press release with a transaction hash. The ledger records both with the same indifference.

traits.label: Irreversibility
traits.text: The destination has no key and never did.

traits.label: Policy
traits.text: Sometimes genuine supply discipline.

traits.label: Theatre
traits.text: Sometimes a livestream in search of a headline.

traits.label: Proof
traits.text: Anyone can verify it, which is the appeal.

cards.flavor: Rarity is not the same as wanted.

cards.name: The Stablecoin
cards.subtitle: One, Until It Isn't

abilities.name: Hold The Peg
abilities.text: Trades at one through crashes, holidays, and three separate bank failures.

abilities.name: Base Pair
abilities.text: Becomes the unit everyone quotes, including the people who distrust it.

abilities.name: Depeg
abilities.text: Prints ninety-six cents for six hours and rewrites everyone's risk model.

cards.weakness: The reserve is somewhere else entirely.
cards.lore: The Stablecoin is the most used and least examined object in this world. It carries the settlement traffic of an entire industry on the strength of an attestation. For six hours one weekend it wobbled, and everybody suddenly read the footnotes.

traits.label: Ubiquity
traits.text: The quote currency for nearly everything.

traits.label: Reserves
traits.text: Backed by assets held under someone else's roof.

traits.label: Utility
traits.text: Moves value across borders faster than any wire.

traits.label: Fragility
traits.text: Confidence is the collateral that actually matters.

cards.flavor: One dollar, subject to a footnote.

cards.name: The Governance Token
cards.subtitle: Voice, Weighted by Wallet

abilities.name: Propose
abilities.text: Opens a forum thread that four people read and nine hundred quote.

abilities.name: Quorum Failure
abilities.text: Most votes fail to reach the threshold and pass by exhaustion instead.

abilities.name: Whale Vote
abilities.text: One wallet decides the outcome an hour before the deadline closes.

cards.weakness: One wallet, one vote, many wallets.
cards.lore: The Governance Token promises a parliament and usually delivers a shareholder meeting with better graphics. Participation is low, delegation is fashionable, and the largest holder is patient. When the vote matters, the outcome arrives from a single address at the last hour.

traits.label: Ceremony
traits.text: The vote is real; the result was arithmetic.

traits.label: Apathy
traits.text: Almost nobody votes until the treasury is threatened.

traits.label: Delegation
traits.text: Power collects quietly with a few reliable names.

traits.label: Legitimacy
traits.text: Still better than no process at all.

cards.flavor: A parliament where votes are purchasable.

cards.name: The Meme Coin
cards.subtitle: A Joke With a Market Cap

abilities.name: Go Viral
abilities.text: Gains a hundred thousand holders in a weekend on no fundamentals whatsoever.

abilities.name: Honest Absurdity
abilities.text: Promises nothing, and therefore cannot technically fail to deliver.

abilities.name: Culture Coin
abilities.text: Outlives the serious projects that mocked it, purely on affection.

cards.weakness: Attention is the only reserve asset.
cards.lore: The Meme Coin is the most honest instrument here: it claims nothing and is priced accordingly. Its holders are not deceived, merely gambling in public with a shared punchline. Occasionally the joke becomes a tribe, and the tribe outlives the cycle.

traits.label: Honesty
traits.text: Never pretended to solve anything.

traits.label: Belonging
traits.text: The community is the product.

traits.label: Velocity
traits.text: Rises and falls faster than any thesis can be written.

traits.label: Survival
traits.text: A few become culture and never leave.

cards.flavor: It promised nothing and kept its word.

cards.name: The Wrapped Token
cards.subtitle: A Coin About a Coin

abilities.name: Mint Receipt
abilities.text: Issues a token representing an asset locked somewhere the holder cannot see.

abilities.name: Trade Anywhere
abilities.text: Lets a foreign asset behave natively on a chain that never met it.

abilities.name: Unwrap
abilities.text: Redeems for the original, assuming the original is still there.

cards.weakness: It is a claim wearing a coin's face.
cards.lore: The Wrapped Token makes incompatible worlds trade smoothly by adding a layer of trust nobody discusses. It behaves like the real asset until the day the vault behind it does not. Convenience and counterparty risk have never been packaged so neatly.

traits.label: Mimicry
traits.text: Moves and prices exactly like the asset it represents.

traits.label: Custody
traits.text: Somewhere, a vault must actually hold the original.

traits.label: Utility
traits.text: Unlocks liquidity that would otherwise sit idle.

traits.label: Assumption
traits.text: The peg holds while nobody tests it.

cards.flavor: A perfect likeness of somebody else's asset.

cards.name: The Mint
cards.subtitle: Supply, Summoned

abilities.name: Issue
abilities.text: Creates supply from a function call and a moment of governance.

abilities.name: Dilution
abilities.text: Every new unit quietly borrows value from every existing holder.

abilities.name: Infinite Mint
abilities.text: One flawed permission turns a fixed supply into a rounding error.

cards.weakness: A mint key is a promise to be broken.
cards.lore: Creation is the easiest operation in this world and the hardest to justify. Emissions fund growth, growth funds emissions, and holders pay for both without an invoice. The most catastrophic failures were not thefts but mint functions left within reach.

traits.label: Ease
traits.text: One call creates what took years to accumulate.

traits.label: Dilution
traits.text: Charged to existing holders, never itemised.

traits.label: Growth
traits.text: Emissions rent activity that leaves when they stop.

traits.label: Key Risk
traits.text: Whoever holds the mint holds everything.

cards.flavor: Anyone with the key owns the supply.

cards.name: The Snapshot
cards.subtitle: The Hour That Counted

abilities.name: Capture
abilities.text: Freezes every balance at one block and calls that history.

abilities.name: Retroactive
abilities.text: Rewards behaviour from months ago that nobody knew was being graded.

abilities.name: Missed By One
abilities.text: Excludes a wallet that qualified for years and moved on the wrong day.

cards.weakness: It is announced after it happens.
cards.lore: The Snapshot turns a random block into the only moment that ever mattered. Years of participation are graded by a single frame, chosen quietly and revealed later. Everyone who consolidated wallets that morning learns something about timing.

traits.label: Instant
traits.text: One block decides who counts.

traits.label: Secrecy
traits.text: Kept quiet so behaviour stays honest.

traits.label: Arbitrary
traits.text: The threshold is a number somebody picked.

traits.label: Grief
traits.text: Near misses are permanent and unappealable.

cards.flavor: One block decided who was there.

cards.name: The Multisig
cards.subtitle: No One Hand Alone

abilities.name: Require Signers
abilities.text: Moves nothing until three of five people agree in writing.

abilities.name: Shared Fate
abilities.text: One compromised laptop is an inconvenience rather than a catastrophe.

abilities.name: Deadlock
abilities.text: Two signers vanish and the treasury becomes a monument to good intentions.

cards.weakness: Coordination is slower than theft.
cards.lore: The Multisig replaces trust in a person with trust in a quorum, which is a genuine improvement and a genuine burden. Every emergency now requires a group chat and three time zones. Treasuries survive on it, and occasionally freeze under it.

traits.label: Quorum
traits.text: Power divided so that no single key is fatal.

traits.label: Friction
traits.text: Every payment becomes a small committee meeting.

traits.label: Resilience
traits.text: Survives the loss of any one participant.

traits.label: Deadlock
traits.text: Survives everything except a scattered signer set.

cards.flavor: Three keys, five people, one slow decision.

cards.name: The Faucet
cards.subtitle: A Trickle for Beginners

abilities.name: Drip
abilities.text: Hands a stranger enough coin to make one first transaction.

abilities.name: Onboarding
abilities.text: Turns curiosity into a wallet without asking anyone for money.

abilities.name: Early Fortune
abilities.text: Gives away, in one afternoon, an amount later worth a house.

cards.weakness: Bots drink faster than beginners.
cards.lore: In the first years the coins were free because nobody believed they were worth anything. The Faucet gave away fortunes to anyone patient enough to solve a puzzle. Its descendants dispense test tokens, and the legend does the rest.

traits.label: Welcome
traits.text: The first coin arrives as a gift.

traits.label: Trickle
traits.text: Enough to try, never enough to matter.

traits.label: Legend
traits.text: Early drips became fortunes and dinner-party regrets.

traits.label: Siege
traits.text: Every free thing attracts scripts before people.

cards.flavor: The first coins were given away free.

cards.name: The Whale Alert
cards.subtitle: A Siren for Every Wave

abilities.name: Sound Alarm
abilities.text: Announces a transfer of enormous size and unknown meaning to everyone.

abilities.name: Context Free
abilities.text: Never distinguishes an internal reshuffle from an actual intention to sell.

abilities.name: Cascade Fear
abilities.text: One routine custody move empties the order book within ninety seconds.

cards.weakness: Most large transfers mean nothing.
cards.lore: The Alert is factually correct and almost always misleading. A number moves, a siren fires, and thousands of people supply the story themselves. The chain reports motion; panic supplies intent.

traits.label: Immediacy
traits.text: Faster than any explanation could travel.

traits.label: Ambiguity
traits.text: Cannot tell housekeeping from a decision.

traits.label: Reflex
traits.text: Sells first and reads the thread afterward.

traits.label: Ritual
traits.text: The same alarm every week, believed every time.

cards.flavor: Motion is not intent, and never was.

cards.name: The Rugged Chat
cards.subtitle: Ten Thousand Silent Members

abilities.name: Pin Apology
abilities.text: Leaves a final message about circumstances beyond anyone's reasonable control.

abilities.name: Silence
abilities.text: Ten thousand members, four messages a month, all of them questions.

abilities.name: Last Believer
abilities.text: One member posts the roadmap annually to an audience of bots.

cards.weakness: Nobody with answers is still here.
cards.lore: The channel survives the project by years, a room full of people who never left. The pinned message still describes a launch that happened to someone else. Occasionally a newcomer asks whether the team is active, and the silence answers.

traits.label: Wake
traits.text: A room that outlived the thing it gathered for.

traits.label: Pinned Lie
traits.text: The last announcement is still at the top.

traits.label: Loyalty
traits.text: Somebody still checks in every year.

traits.label: Echo
traits.text: Questions arrive; nothing answers them.

cards.flavor: Ten thousand members, four messages this year.

cards.name: The Newcomer
cards.subtitle: Arrives at the Top

abilities.name: First Buy
abilities.text: Enters at the loudest possible moment with the smallest possible plan.

abilities.name: Beginner Luck
abilities.text: The first trade works, which is the most expensive lesson available.

abilities.name: Stay Curious
abilities.text: Survives the first winter and becomes the only kind of veteran.

cards.weakness: Everything is new, including the traps.
cards.lore: The Newcomer hears about this world exactly when it is most crowded and least forgiving. The first purchase is emotional, the first loss is educational, and the second cycle decides everything. Most leave, and the ones who stay learned it here.

traits.label: Wonder
traits.text: Finds the mechanism genuinely beautiful before finding the price.

traits.label: Timing
traits.text: Arrives when the story is loudest.

traits.label: Naivety
traits.text: Trusts the first confident voice encountered.

traits.label: Potential
traits.text: Becomes a veteran or a cautionary tale.

cards.flavor: Everyone arrives at the top exactly once.

cards.name: The Lurker
cards.subtitle: Reads Everything, Says Nothing

abilities.name: Read Everything
abilities.text: Consumes four years of forum history without leaving a single reply.

abilities.name: No Footprint
abilities.text: Cannot be argued with, quoted, or held to any prior position.

abilities.name: Quiet Entry
abilities.text: Acts once, correctly, and tells absolutely nobody about it.

cards.weakness: Knowing is not the same as doing.
cards.lore: The Lurker learns more than the loudest voices and risks less than the quietest ones. Every thread is read, every mistake is watched from a safe distance, and nothing is ever posted. Whether this is wisdom or paralysis depends on which cycle is being discussed.

traits.label: Absorption
traits.text: Learns from arguments without entering them.

traits.label: Discretion
traits.text: Leaves no post to regret later.

traits.label: Hesitation
traits.text: Waits for a certainty that never arrives.

traits.label: Advantage
traits.text: Free from the burden of a public position.

cards.flavor: The quietest account has read the most.

cards.name: The Screenshotter
cards.subtitle: Gains Only, Please

abilities.name: Capture Green
abilities.text: Posts the one position that worked, cropped away from the others.

abilities.name: Crop
abilities.text: The account balance is always somewhere outside the visible frame.

abilities.name: Survivorship
abilities.text: Convinces an entire timeline that this is the normal outcome.

cards.weakness: Losses are never screenshotted.
cards.lore: Every winning trade is documented and every losing one is a private matter. The result is a public record of an imaginary trader assembled from real screenshots. Newcomers calibrate their expectations against it and cannot understand why.

traits.label: Curation
traits.text: Publishes wins and archives everything else.

traits.label: Cropping
traits.text: The truth is always just outside the frame.

traits.label: Distortion
traits.text: Sets an impossible baseline for everyone watching.

traits.label: Ritual
traits.text: The screenshot arrives before the position closes.

cards.flavor: The frame ends where the losses begin.

cards.name: The Charting Mystic
cards.subtitle: Lines Upon Lines

abilities.name: Draw Lines
abilities.text: Finds a channel, a triangle, and a prophecy in identical data.

abilities.name: Both Paths
abilities.text: Charts a bullish case and a bearish case on the same image.

abilities.name: Invalidation
abilities.text: Redraws the level, declares the setup invalidated, and posts an updated chart.

cards.weakness: Every pattern is obvious afterward.
cards.lore: The Mystic reads the market the way earlier centuries read entrails, with more colours and better software. Some of it is real risk management wearing costume jewellery. The rest is a horoscope with a price axis, and it moves capital either way.

traits.label: Geometry
traits.text: Every chart contains a line that explains it.

traits.label: Hedging
traits.text: Publishes both outcomes and claims whichever arrives.

traits.label: Discipline
traits.text: The good ones are simply risk managers in disguise.

traits.label: Faith
traits.text: Believes the pattern before the volume confirms it.

cards.flavor: Two arrows, one chart, guaranteed accuracy.

cards.name: The Support Line
cards.subtitle: Held, Until It Didn't

abilities.name: Hold
abilities.text: Bounces price four times and earns the trust of everyone watching.

abilities.name: Gathering
abilities.text: Collects orders, hope, and stop losses in the same narrow band.

abilities.name: Give Way
abilities.text: Breaks on the fifth test and becomes resistance by morning.

cards.weakness: Every level that holds is eventually tested again.
cards.lore: A support line is a rumour that enough people believe to make temporarily true. It works because it is watched, and it fails because it is crowded. Once broken, the same price becomes a ceiling, and the same crowd defends the other side.

traits.label: Consensus
traits.text: Real only while enough people agree it is.

traits.label: Magnetism
traits.text: Draws orders toward a number for no physical reason.

traits.label: Fatigue
traits.text: Each successful test makes the next one weaker.

traits.label: Inversion
traits.text: Becomes resistance the moment it fails.

cards.flavor: A level is a rumour with enough believers.

cards.name: The Resistance Line
cards.subtitle: The Ceiling Remembers

abilities.name: Reject
abilities.text: Turns price away at the exact number that trapped everyone last year.

abilities.name: Trapped Supply
abilities.text: Every prior buyer waits here to escape at break-even.

abilities.name: Break Through
abilities.text: Clears the ceiling on real volume and turns it into a floor.

cards.weakness: Enough demand erases any ceiling.
cards.lore: Resistance is the memory of everyone who bought too high and never sold. The level holds because grief is patient and break-even is a powerful motivator. When it finally clears, the sellers are gone, and the ceiling becomes ground.

traits.label: Grief
traits.text: Built from positions waiting to get out even.

traits.label: Memory
traits.text: The market remembers the price it regretted.

traits.label: Weight
traits.text: Each rejection adds conviction to the next one.

traits.label: Reversal
traits.text: Once broken, defends from below.

cards.flavor: The ceiling is made of other people's regret.

cards.name: The Candlestick
cards.subtitle: Four Numbers, One Story

abilities.name: Print
abilities.text: Records open, high, low, and close without editorial comment.

abilities.name: Compression
abilities.text: Holds an entire hour of argument in a single coloured rectangle.

abilities.name: Long Wick
abilities.text: Shows a price that existed for four seconds and mattered for months.

cards.weakness: It records the what, never the why.
cards.lore: Older than every asset it now describes, the candlestick was drawn for rice merchants and inherited by this market unchanged. Four numbers and a colour compress thousands of decisions into a shape. Everything else on the chart is interpretation.

traits.label: Economy
traits.text: Four numbers describe an entire session.

traits.label: Neutrality
traits.text: Reports without opinion or flattery.

traits.label: Inheritance
traits.text: Older than the market it now serves.

traits.label: Wicks
traits.text: The extremes matter more than the body.

cards.flavor: Four numbers, and every story inside them.

cards.name: The Order Book
cards.subtitle: Every Intention, Priced

abilities.name: Stack
abilities.text: Displays every resting bid and offer, sorted by price and time.

abilities.name: Spoof
abilities.text: Half the visible size vanishes the instant anyone attempts to take it.

abilities.name: Air Pocket
abilities.text: Reveals a gap where the depth was pretending to be.

cards.weakness: Displayed size is not committed size.
cards.lore: The Order Book looks like the truest picture of a market and is partly theatre. Resting orders are intentions, and intentions can be withdrawn in a millisecond. What matters is not the wall that is showing but the depth that stays when tested.

traits.label: Ledger
traits.text: Every intention, ranked by price and patience.

traits.label: Illusion
traits.text: Size can be displayed without being meant.

traits.label: Depth
traits.text: The truth appears only when something is taken.

traits.label: Priority
traits.text: First in line at a price wins the fill.

cards.flavor: The wall is real until somebody hits it.

cards.name: The Spread
cards.subtitle: The Cost of Being Impatient

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.text: Collects the difference between wanting in and wanting out.

abilities.name: Widen
abilities.text: Grows in exactly the conditions where crossing it feels most urgent.

abilities.name: Thin Hours
abilities.text: Turns a modest position into a bad fill at three in the morning.

cards.weakness: It rewards anyone willing to wait.
cards.lore: The Spread is the fee for immediacy, charged silently on every crossing. In liquid hours it is a rounding error; in frightened hours it is the whole loss. It is the most honest cost in the market, because it is displayed and still ignored.

traits.label: Immediacy
traits.text: Paid by whoever refuses to wait for a fill.

traits.label: Elasticity
traits.text: Widest when the need is greatest.

traits.label: Accumulation
traits.text: Small each time, enormous across a year.

traits.label: Disclosure
traits.text: Always visible, rarely considered.

cards.flavor: Impatience is billed at the touch.

cards.name: The Volume Spike
